data.title: Arthur Hayes Says Quantum Computing Is No Reason to Sell Bitcoin. The Real Risk Is One Common Habit.
data.description: BitMEX co-founder Arthur Hayes says quantum computing fears have Bitcoin holders spooked for the wrong reason, and the actual vulnerability hiding in plain sight has nothing to do with the technology itself.
